question: The Fundamental Rights is mentioned in which Part of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PART III**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Six fundamental rights are recognized by the Indian constitution.__

 
• Under Part-III (article 12 - 35) of the constitution, every citizen has provided 6 fundamental rights.
 
• A total of seven rights were originally provided by the Constitution.<
